title: Reports that must wait: the ready queue
summary: Two new work reports arrive, each naming a prerequisite package that has not been accumulated yet. Neither is accumulatable, so both join the ready queue with their unmet dependencies. One depends on a report already in the queue, so this forms a chain that unlocks in order once its first link accumulates.
params: the tiny chain the v0.8.0 vectors were made with ($\mathsf{E}$ = 12 slots per epoch, $\mathsf{Y}$ = 10, $\mathsf{C}$ = 2 cores, 6 validators)
notes: A report with no prerequisites and no segment-root lookups is accumulatable at once ($\mathbf{R}^!$); the others go to the queue with their dependencies minus what is already accumulated, and leave it when the last dependency is accumulated.
name: accumulate-queue
check: The model's posterior state, statistics and output root equal the vector's expected output (the comparison `acctest` makes). The accumulate suite as a whole is suspended until v0.8.1 vectors exist, because most of its services are v0.8.0 programs; this vector is one of those that pass.
